todos.description: Deduplicate data/superconductor_database.json: YH6 appears 6 times with conflicting Tc values (200 K, 220 K, 224 K, 227 K, etc.), LaH10 appears 2+ times, C-S-H appears 3+ times, CaH6 appears 3+ times, Li2MgH16 appears 4+ times, and many other materials have duplicate entries; keep one entry per unique material with the most reliable Tc value and reference, removing conflicting duplicates that corrupt ML training

Add dedicated 2025–2026 breakthrough sections to root-level proposed_chemistry_physics.md: LaSc₂H₂₄ (first reproducible RT superconductor, Tc 271–298 K at ~260 GPa, hexagonal clathrate, Sc-induced gap unification), Zentropy theory (first-principles Tc prediction bridging BCS and DFT, validated on 18 elements + YBa₂Cu₃O₇), pressure-quench protocol (PQP) for Hg-1223 (ambient-pressure Tc record 151 K, Deng & Chu 2026), H₃S tunneling gap anomaly (first direct gap measurement ~60 meV, isotope-effect confirmation), deep-learning discovery of 144 ternary hydrides (Wang et al., arXiv:2502.16558), nickelate advances (La₃Ni₂O₇ single crystals Tc up to 96 K, ambient-pressure thin films >40 K), AI causal discovery (Fujitsu/Tohoku on CsV₃Sb₅ kagome ARPES), updated manufacturing roadmap (PQP, chemical precompression, Mg₄Pt₃H₆ ambient-stable hydrides), and prioritized candidate table with latest Tc/pressure data

Update docs/proposed_chemistry_physics.md stub cross-reference table to accurately list all section headings present in the root-level proposed_chemistry_physics.md after the breakthrough sections are added; remove any claims about sections that do not exist (currently claims 7 breakthroughs are 'documented in full' in the root file, which is false)
